newsitem.title: USA: Aronex Nyotranin interim results positive.
newsitem.headline: Aronex Nyotranin interim results positive.

text.p: Aronex Pharmaceuticals Inc said Thursday that interim results have shown Nyotranin, a treatment for a life-threatening fungal blood infection, to be well-tolerated.
Seventy-four percent of the evaluable patients treated with Nyotran in a Phase II/III study responded to therapy, remaining free of infection six weeks after treatment, the company said.
The company also said investigators assessed no reports of drug-related fever and chills, which are often associated with other therapies for systemic fungal infections.
"These results suggest that Nyotranin may be an effective and safe alternative to currently available systemic antifungal therapies," Aronex said.
Nyotranin is a formulation of the antifungal drug nystatin and is Aronex's lead product. The company said it expects to complete the U.S. Phase III trial, now under way, in late 1997.
